defs.def: the series of jobs that a person has in a particular area of work, usually involving more responsibility as time passes 生涯；职业

ex.s: avoided oil painting practiceB. sought for a painting career
ex.t: 回避油画练习　B. 寻求从事绘画生涯

ex.s: As a result, the first four years of my postgraduate career were defined by a series of failures.
ex.t: 结果，我研究生生涯的头四年被一系列的失败所定义。

ex.s: Make career plans and set goals.
ex.t: 制定职业规划并设定目标。

ex.s: With a Handshake account, students can receive information about career events and personalized job recommendations.
ex.t: 有了Handshake账户，学生可以接收职业活动信息和个性化的工作推荐。

ex.s: You can also make appointments to meet with a career coach, access career resources, and explore careers that interest you.
ex.t: 你还可以预约与职业教练见面、获取职业资源，并探索你感兴趣的职业。

ex.s: For more information, find us at Career Development Office, 211Hughes Hall; careerdevelopment@dreamcollege.edu, 555-520-1314
ex.t: 如需更多信息，请前往211号休斯大厦职业发展办公室；careerdevelopment@dreamcollege.edu，555-520-1314

ex.s: consult a career coachB. personalize your profile
ex.t: 咨询职业教练 B. 完善你的个人资料

ex.s: To prepare for a new career
ex.t: 为了准备一份新职业。

ex.s: That movie led him into the second half of his career where his comedic presence alone could make a movie a financial success even when movie reviewers would not rate it highly.
ex.t: 那部电影将他带入了职业生涯的下半场，在那个阶段，仅凭他的喜剧魅力就能让一部电影在商业上获得成功，即使影评人评价不高。

ex.s: He built a hugely successful career with little more than plain old hard work and determination.
ex.t: 他仅凭朴实的努力和决心，就建立了极其成功的职业生涯。

ex.s: What do we know about Nielsen in the second half of his career?
ex.t: 关于尼尔森职业生涯后半段我们知道什么？

ex.s: What does Nielsen’s career story tell us?
ex.t: 尼尔森的职业生涯告诉我们什么？

ex.s: To make a difference in his dull medical career.
ex.t: 为了让他单调的行医生涯有所不同。

ex.s: I probably would have continued trying to keep up with him for the rest of my high school career, but when my family moved, everything changed.
ex.t: 我永远无法踢好足球或打好篮球。

ex.s: He was also a good player, but his career was interrupted during World War Ⅱ.
ex.t: 他也是一名好球员，但他的职业生涯在二战期间中断了。

ex.s: Moore physicist mathematician chemist astronomer geographer biologist 1 What do you know about these careers?
ex.t: 摩尔　物理学家　数学家　化学家　天文学家　地理学家　生物学家　1 你对这些职业了解多少？

ex.s: It wasn’t until1980 - 32 years into his career — that he landed the role it would seem he was made for in Airplane!
ex.t: 直到1980年——他职业生涯的第32年——他才得到那个似乎为他量身打造的角色，即在《飞机！》中出演。

ex.s: To suggest a way of pursuing excellence in our lifelong career．
ex.t: D．为我们终身职业追求卓越提出一种方法。

defs.def: the period of time that you spend in your life working or doing a particular thing 经历；事业

ex.s: Did Nielsen then feel content in his career?
ex.t: Nielsen当时对自己的事业感到满足吗？

ex.s: I had put so much time and emotional energy into applying, and I thought the rejection meant the end of the road for my science career.
ex.t: 我在申请上投入了那么多时间和情感精力，我以为那封拒信意味着我的科学事业走到了尽头。

ex.s: I want to focus on my band and have a career in music when I leave school.
ex.t: 我想专注于我的乐队，毕业后从事音乐事业。

ex.s: What about your future career as a lawyer?!
ex.t: 那你将来当律师的事业怎么办？！

ex.s: Grandfather: Yes, and you have found the career that suits your talents.
ex.t: 祖父：是的，而且你已经找到了适合你才华的事业。

ex.s: She decided to go back to college to advance her career and to be able to better support her family while doing something she loves: nursing.
ex.t: 她决定回到大学深造，以推进自己的事业，并在从事自己热爱的工作——护理——的同时，更好地支撑家庭。

ex.s: As working from home becomes              common, people are finding it easier to combine parenthood with a full-time career.
ex.t: 随着在家工作变得              常见人们发现更容易将育儿与全职事业结合起来。
